BOR COMPLAINT TYPE: P
As a result of the review of your complaint, after consideration of any evidence and facts pursuant to their powers
and authority under the lllinois Property Tax Code, George A. Cardenas, Samantha Steele and Larry R. Rogers Jr.
Commissioners of the Board of Review of Cook County, are pleased to inform you that as a result of the review of
your complaint they have directed the Assessor to reduce the assessed value of your property as shown below:
:                             2022 Assessed Valuations
05-17-302-010-0000           2319354-001                82,000                        62,800                               19,200
If you are dissatisfied with your 2022 real estate assessment, you have the following options:
1. You may appeal this decision to the Property Tax Appeal Board at the Stratton Office Building, Room 402, 401
South Spring Street, Spfingfield, Illinois 62706-0002, Tel:217-782-6076, by filing a petition for review with the
Illinois Property Tax Apgeal Board within 30 days after the date of this notice or within 30 days after the date the
Board of Review transmits to the County Assessor pursuant to Sec 16-125 (35 ILCS 200/16-125) its final action on
the township in which your property is located, whichever is later.
—OR—                     &
2. You may request a Ré-Review with the Cook County Board of Review. Re-Review Dates are published on our
website at www.cookcountyboardofreview.com in the “Dates and Deadline” section. A Re-Review is a courtesy, it
is not mandatory, and the request for Re-Review may be denied.
-OR—                     Hy
3. You may file a tax objection complaint in the Circuit Court of Cook County, Illinois. If you choose this option,
please consult the laws.concerning the procedure for proceeding in court. In addition, you may file a new complaint
at the Board of Review pext year for 2023 with any new evidence.
